description: The idle wait runs out while a burst from the peer, carrying part of a C_PDU addressed to this node, is still arriving: the decision waits for the burst's end, when the peer counts as heard and the wait counts again from then; with nothing more heard, the link is then closed as idle.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ at 0. As sis-session/idle-heard-partial up to 83550: the soft link is established at 57550 with an idle time of 90000, the peer's DATA-ONLY FSN 0 at 61000 restarts the wait to 151000 (A-0320), and our ACK-ONLY ends at 83550. At 149000 a new burst from the peer begins; at 150000 its DATA-ONLY FSN 1 (C_PDU start but not end, EOT 10) arrives addressed to this node: the C_PDU is not complete, so nothing reaches the SIS. At 151000 the idle wait expires while the burst is still being received. The burst may carry more of the peer's C_PDU, so the decision waits for its end (A-0320): no output. The burst ends at 152000. The DTS records the peer as heard addressing this node in a burst begun at 149000 and ended at 152000 (C-0833); then the deferred decision is taken: the burst began after the wait did (149000 is not before 61000), so the link is not idle and the wait counts again from the end of that burst, 152000 + 90000 = 242000: it restarts with 90000 (A-0320). Then the MAC: an acknowledgement is owed and the EOT end 150000 + 5000 = 155000 is still ahead, so csma.vdcd_end 3000 (K-0071). At 155000 csma.vdcd_end expires: LBT rule 1 and contention, the third draw of seed 0 (15) giving 45000 (K-0080). At 200000 the ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 2) goes out, one block, ending at 205550. At 242000 the wait expires again with no burst arriving. The peer was last heard in the burst begun at 149000, before the wait's count began at 152000, so the link is idle: the SIS closes it with Idle Soft Link Terminated (A-0196, A-0205), sis.soft_link_max stops, and the CAS goes straight to Step 1 (B-0317, B-0421): link_state breaking and LBT 3000 after our own transmission (K-0074). The rest of the break is as sis-session/idle-break. Fixture and addresses as sis-session/idle-break.
